Name: FFXIV Zenos Cow Replacement Mod
Author: Crecentbone
Description:
This mod pack turns all white cows into a naked Zenos from Final Fantasy XIV. No, I'm not joking.

There is no baby cow version of Zenos, so when the cow matures it evolves into a grown ass naked man.

Just plop this bad boy into your mods folder for the game. Requires SMAPI and ContentPatcher
